introduction: Tansu is a decentralized governance platform operated by Consulting Manao GmbH, Söding-Sankt Johann, Austria. By using our dApp, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.
importantNotice: The dApp runs in your browser and reads the Stellar blockchain, IPFS and git hosts directly. We keep no user database; the upload service we run puts your files on IPFS. We recommend reading our Privacy Policy alongside these Terms.

keyPoints.title: Age Requirement
keyPoints.content: You must be at least 18 years old to use our services.

keyPoints.title: Free Service
keyPoints.content: Tansu is provided free of charge. Users only pay blockchain transaction fees.

keyPoints.title: Wallet Required
keyPoints.content: You must use a third-party Stellar wallet to authenticate your account.

keyPoints.title: Content Responsibility
keyPoints.content: You are solely responsible for all content you upload to IPFS.

keyPoints.title: Reporting Illegal Content
keyPoints.content: We host the files you upload. Report content you consider illegal to legal@consulting-manao.com, in German or English. A person reviews each report and tells you the outcome.

keyPoints.title: Collateral System
keyPoints.content: Proposals require collateral, reimbursed to the proposer upon successful execution.

keyPoints.title: No Advice
keyPoints.content: Tansu is a governance tool. Nothing in it is financial, investment, tax or legal advice.

keyPoints.title: Austrian Law
keyPoints.content: These Terms are governed by Austrian law. The courts of Graz have jurisdiction as far as the law allows; consumers keep the mandatory protections of their country of residence.

keyPoints.title: Changes
keyPoints.content: A change to these Terms applies from the day it is published. If you do not accept it, stop using the service.

importantRisks.title: Blockchain Risks
importantRisks.content: Transactions are permanent and cannot be reversed. Cryptocurrency prices fluctuate significantly.

importantRisks.title: IPFS Content
importantRisks.content: Content uploaded to IPFS is public and permanent. It remains accessible even if unlinked from our platform.

importantRisks.title: Anonymous Voting
importantRisks.content: Lost private keys prevent vote decryption and proposal execution. No recovery mechanism exists.

importantRisks.title: No Recourse
importantRisks.content: Lost keys, failed transactions and errors on the blockchain cannot be reversed.

yourResponsibilities: Use services in compliance with Austrian law and these Terms
Secure your wallet and private keys
Provide accurate information when using our services
Ensure uploaded content complies with laws and doesn't infringe on others' rights

Do not attempt to compromise platform security
